40023005.author: पदार्थः
40023005.content: रजन्याम् in the night, तु and, प्रभातायाम् having dawned, समानीय having assembled, महामुनीन् the great sages, गीयताम् let it be sung, अविशङ्काभ्याम् fearlessly, रामः Rama, पुत्रौ to his sons, उवाच said, ह indeed.

40023005.author: Translation
40023005.content: When the night dawned, Rama assembled the great sages and instructed his sons, Kusha and Lava, to sing the Ramayana fearlessly.

40023006.author: पदार्थः
40023006.content: ततः then, समुपविष्टेषु when they were seated, ब्रह्मर्षिषु the Brahmarishis, महात्मसु the great-souled ones, भविष्यत् future, उत्तरम् latter part, काव्यम् the epic, जगतुः they sang, तौ those two, कुशीलवौ Kusha and Lava.

40023006.author: Translation
40023006.content: Then, as the great-souled Brahmarishis were seated, Kusha and Lava sang the future, latter part of the epic.

40023007.author: पदार्थः
40023007.content: प्रविष्टायाम् when she entered, तु and, सीतायाम् Sita, भूतलम् the earth, सत्यसम्पदा by the power of her truth, तस्य of that, अवसाने at the conclusion, यज्ञस्य of the sacrifice, रामः Rama, परमदुर्मनाः extremely distressed.

40023007.author: Translation
40023007.content: And when Sita entered the earth by the power of her truth, at the conclusion of that sacrifice, Rama became extremely distressed.

40023008.author: पदार्थः
40023008.content: अपश्यमानो not seeing, वैदेहीं Vaidehi, मेने he considered, शून्यम् empty, इदं this, जगत् world, शोकेन by sorrow, परमायस्तो greatly distressed, न not, शान्तिं peace, मनसा in mind, अगमत् he attained.

40023008.author: Translation
40023008.content: Unable to see Vaidehi, he considered this world empty, and being greatly distressed by sorrow, he could not attain peace of mind.

40023009.author: पदार्थः
40023009.content: विसृज्य having dismissed, पार्थिवान् kings, सर्वान् all, ऋक्षवानरराक्षसान् bears, monkeys, and rakshasas, जनौघं multitude of people, विप्रमुख्यानां of chief Brahmins, वित्तपूर्वं with gifts of wealth, विसृज्य having dismissed, च and.

40023009.author: Translation
40023009.content: Having dismissed all the kings, bears, monkeys, and rakshasas, and also having sent away the multitude of chief Brahmins with gifts of wealth.

40023010.author: पदार्थः
40023010.content: एवं thus, समाप्य having concluded, यज्ञं the sacrifice, तु indeed, विधिवत् according to rites, स he, तु indeed, राघवः Rama, ततो then, विसृज्य having dismissed, तान् them, सर्वान् all, रामः Rama, राजीवलोचनः lotus-eyed.

40023010.author: Translation
40023010.content: Thus, having properly concluded the sacrifice, that Rama, the descendant of Raghu, the lotus-eyed, then dismissed all of them.

40023011.author: पदार्थः
40023011.content: हृदि in his heart, कृत्वा having placed, तदा then, सीताम् Sita, अयोध्यां Ayodhya, प्रविवेश he entered, ह indeed, इष्टयज्ञो one who has performed sacrifices, नरपतिः king, पुत्रद्वयसमन्वितः accompanied by two sons.

40023011.author: Translation
40023011.content: Then, keeping Sita in his heart, that king, who had performed sacrifices and was accompanied by his two sons, entered Ayodhya.

40023012.author: पदार्थः
40023012.content: न not, सीतायाः than Sita, परां another, भार्यां wife, वव्रे he chose, स he, रघुनन्दनः Rama, यज्ञे in sacrifice, यज्ञे in sacrifice, च and, पत्न्यर्थं as a wife, जानकी Janaki, काञ्चनी golden, भवत् she was.

40023012.author: Translation
40023012.content: That Rama, the delight of Raghu, did not choose another wife besides Sita, and in every sacrifice, a golden image of Janaki served as his wife.

40023013.author: पदार्थः
40023013.content: दशवर्षसहस्राणि ten thousand years, वाजिमेघान् Ashwamedha sacrifices, अथ then, अकरोत् he performed, वाजपेयान् Vajapeya sacrifices, दशगुणान् ten times (more), तथा and, बहुसुवर्णकान् with much gold.

40023013.author: Translation
40023013.content: For ten thousand years, he performed Ashwamedha sacrifices, and also Vajapeya sacrifices that were ten times grander and involved abundant gold.

40023014.author: पदार्थः
40023014.content: अग्निष्टोमातिरात्राभ्याम् with Agnishtoma and Atiratra (sacrifices), गोसवैः with Gosava sacrifices, च and, महाधनैः with great wealth, ईजे he performed sacrifices, क्रतुभिः with sacrifices, अन्यैः other, च and, सः he, श्रीमान् the glorious one, आप्तदक्षिणैः with ample dakshina.

40023014.author: Translation
40023014.content: The glorious Rama performed other sacrifices like Agnishtoma, Atiratra, and Gosava, which were accompanied by great wealth and ample gifts.

40023015.author: पदार्थः
40023015.content: एवम् thus, सः that, कालः time, सुमहान् very great, राज्यस्थस्य of him ruling the kingdom, महात्मनः of the great-souled one, धर्मे in righteousness, प्रयतमानस्य striving, व्यतीयात् passed away, राघवस्य of Rama, तु indeed.

40023015.author: Translation
40023015.content: Thus, a very long period of time passed for the great-souled Rama, who was established in his kingdom and constantly striving in righteousness.

40023016.author: पदार्थः
40023016.content: अनुरञ्जन्ति they pleased, राजानम् the king, अहन्यहनि day by day, राघवम् Rama, ऋक्षवानररक्षांसि bears, monkeys, and rakshasas, स्थिता abiding, रामस्य of Rama, शासने in the command.

40023016.author: Translation
40023016.content: Day by day, the bears, monkeys, and rakshasas, abiding by Rama's command, continued to please King Rama.

40023017.author: पदार्थः
40023017.content: काले at the proper time, वर्षति rains, पर्जन्यः the rain-god, सुभिक्षम् good harvest, विमलाः clear, दिशः directions, हृष्टपुष्टजनाकीर्णम् filled with happy and well-nourished people, पुरम् the city, जनपदाः the districts, तथा and.

40023017.author: Translation
40023017.content: The rain-god rained at the proper time, there was an abundance of food, the directions were clear, and the city and its districts were filled with happy and well-nourished people.

40023018.author: पदार्थः
40023018.content: नाकाले at an untimely moment, म्रियते dies, कश्चित् anyone, न not, व्याधिः disease, प्राणिनां of living beings, तथा similarly, न not, अनर्थः misfortune, विद्यते exists, कश्चित् any, रामे when Rama, राज्यं the kingdom, प्रशासति was ruling.

40023018.author: Translation
40023018.content: When Rama was ruling the kingdom, no one died an untimely death, nor did any disease afflict living beings, nor did any misfortune exist.

40023019.author: पदार्थः
40023019.content: अथ thereafter, दीर्घस्य of a long, कालस्य period, राममाता Rama's mother (Kausalya), यशस्विनी the illustrious one, पुत्रपौत्रैः by sons and grandsons, परिवृता surrounded, कालधर्मम् the law of time (death), उपागमत् attained.

40023019.author: Translation
40023019.content: After a long period, the illustrious Kausalya, Rama's mother, surrounded by her sons and grandsons, attained the law of time, meaning she passed away.

40023020.author: पदार्थः
40023020.content: अन्वियाय followed, सुमित्रा Sumitra, च and, कैकेयी Kaikeyi, च and, यशस्विनी the illustrious one, धर्मं meritorious deeds, कृत्वा having performed, बहुविधं various kinds of, त्रिदिवे in heaven, पर्यवस्थिता resided.

40023020.author: Translation
40023020.content: Sumitra and the illustrious Kaikeyi also followed, and having performed various kinds of meritorious deeds, they resided in heaven.

40023021.author: पदार्थः
40023021.content: सर्वाः all of them, प्रमुदिताः greatly delighted, स्वर्गे in heaven, राज्ञा with King, दशरथेन Dasharatha, च and, समागताः having reunited, महाभागाः the greatly fortunate ones, सर्वधर्मं all righteousness/merit, च and, लेभिरे obtained.

40023021.author: Translation
40023021.content: All those greatly fortunate queens, reunited with King Dasharatha in heaven, were greatly delighted and obtained all righteousness.

40023022.author: पदार्थः
40023022.content: तासां for them, रामः Rama, महादानं great gifts, काले काले from time to time, प्रयच्छति gives, मातॄणाम् for the mothers, अविशेषेण without distinction, ब्राह्मणेषु to Brahmins, तपस्विषु to ascetics.

40023022.author: Translation
40023022.content: Rama regularly gives great gifts for his mothers, without distinction, to Brahmins and ascetics.

40023023.author: पदार्थः
40023023.content: पित्र्याणि ancestral, ब्रह्मरत्नानि excellent Vedic rituals, यज्ञान् sacrifices, परमदुस्तरान् extremely difficult to perform, चकार performed, रामो Rama, धर्मात्मा the righteous-souled, पितऽन् ancestors, देवान् gods, विवर्धयन् causing to prosper.

40023023.author: Translation
40023023.content: The righteous-souled Rama performed ancestral rites, excellent Vedic rituals, and extremely difficult sacrifices, thereby causing his ancestors and the gods to prosper.

40023024.author: पदार्थः
40023024.content: एवम् thus, वर्षसहस्राणि thousands of years, बहून्यथ many, then, ययुः passed, सुखम् happily, यज्ञैः by sacrifices, बहुविधम् various kinds of, धर्मम् righteousness, वर्धयानस्य of him who was increasing, सर्वदा always.

40023024.author: Translation
40023024.content: Thus, many thousands of years passed happily for him who was always increasing various kinds of righteousness through sacrifices. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे एकोनशततमः सर्गः ।। 99 ।। Thus ends the ninety-ninth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
